newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria condemns Damascus blast, offers support.
newsitem.headline: Algeria condemns Damascus blast, offers support.

text.p: The Algerian government on Monday condemned a New Year's Eve bus bombing in central Damascus as a "barbaric" act designed to undermine Syria's stability.

A Foreign Ministry statement quoted by Algerian state-run radio offered Syria "Algeria's unfailing solidarity after this terrorist attack whose instigators sought to undermine Syria's security and stability".
Syria has accused Israel of responsibility for the blast, in which 11 people were killed and 42 wounded. Israel denied the charge.
